faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Got Questions?
faq.description: Everything you need to know about our products and policies.
faq.sensitiveSkin: Is it safe for sensitive skin?
faq.sensitiveSkinAnswer: Absolutely! All Nadara products are formulated with gentle, natural ingredients that are perfect for sensitive skin. We avoid harsh chemicals, synthetic fragrances, and artificial preservatives. Our products are dermatologically tested and hypoallergenic. However, we always recommend doing a patch test before first use.
faq.deliveryReturns: What are your delivery & return policies?
faq.deliveryReturnsAnswer: We offer worldwide shipping! Standard delivery takes 5-10 business days, while express shipping arrives in 2-4 business days. We accept returns within 30 days of delivery for unopened products in their original packaging. Shipping is free on orders over $75.
faq.ingredientsTransparency: How transparent are you about ingredients?
faq.ingredientsTransparencyAnswer: Complete transparency is at the heart of what we do. Every product page lists the full INCI ingredient list, along with the origin and benefits of each key ingredient. We source directly from certified organic farms in Morocco and maintain full traceability. All our ingredients are 100% natural, cruelty-free, and sustainably sourced.

about.heroSubtitle: A journey from the ancient beauty rituals of Morocco to your daily skincare sanctuary.
about.promiseSubtitle: Where Ancient Wisdom Meets Modern Beauty
about.promiseText1: Nadara was founded on a simple belief: that the most effective skincare comes from nature itself. Our journey began in the sun-drenched valleys of Morocco, where generations of women have guarded the secrets of botanical beauty.
about.promiseText2: We partner directly with women-led cooperatives, ensuring fair trade practices while preserving traditional extraction methods that have been perfected over centuries. Every drop of our oils, every gram of our clay masks, carries the essence of this heritage.
about.promiseText3: Today, Nadara brings these treasures to discerning customers worldwide, never compromising on purity, potency, or our commitment to the planet.
about.sustainabilityTitle: Beauty That Cares for Our Planet
about.sustainabilityText1: Sustainability isn't an afterthought—it's woven into every aspect of what we do. From sourcing to shipping, we minimize our environmental footprint without compromising on quality.
about.sustainabilityText2: Our packaging is made from recycled and recyclable materials. We use glass bottles, biodegradable labels, and plastic-free shipping materials. Our formulas are biodegradable and never tested on animals.

aboutPage.metaDescription: Discover Nadara's story - premium Moroccan skincare rooted in tradition and crafted with care.
aboutPage.heroSubtitle: A journey from the ancient beauty rituals of Morocco to your daily skincare sanctuary.
aboutPage.intro1: I have always believed that true beauty lies not in complicated products, but in simplicity, purity, and the treasures that nature offers us. Over the years, I discovered the richness of Moroccan traditions: vegetable powders, cold-pressed oils, and plants used by our mothers and grandmothers to care for their skin and hair. These ancient rituals, passed down with love, became a source of inspiration.
aboutPage.intro2: But Nadara is not just a brand; it is a story of heart, patience, learning, and creation made by hand, product by product, with a sincere desire to offer healthy, gentle, and effective care.
aboutPage.intro3: Every soap, every serum, every treatment is made in small quantities, with attention and respect, to preserve the quality and purity of the ingredients. Behind each formula lies an intention: to help every woman feel beautiful, confident, and comfortable in her skin, naturally.
aboutPage.intro4: Nadara means a return to the essential, a return to true beauty—a beauty that breathes, that heals, and that reveals the natural radiance of every skin.
aboutPage.missionTitle: Nadara was born to accompany every woman in her natural beauty.
aboutPage.missionLine1: Not to transform, but to reveal.
aboutPage.missionLine2: Not to mask, but to enhance.
aboutPage.story1Desc: At the start, it was not a commercial project but a sincere passion for the natural, beauty, and artisan creation. The desire to understand, learn, and create simple, healthy, and effective skincare was the first step on this adventure. And faced with the difficulties often encountered with industrial products—complex compositions, sometimes exaggerated marketing promises, sometimes very high prices, or products that are too harsh especially for sensitive skin—reflection became necessary.
aboutPage.story2Desc: The first months were devoted to research and experimentation. Testing recipes, discovering the benefits of vegetable powders, natural oils, and gentle actives for skin and hair. Each formula was prepared with patience, often redone, improved, and adjusted until satisfactory quality was achieved.
aboutPage.story3Desc: The choice of the name Nadara is inspired by purity, nature, gentleness, and authenticity. And so Nadara products reached customers' hands; the range expanded with new treatments: serums, natural powders, solid shampoos, body and hair creams. Quality became an absolute priority, with small-batch production to guarantee the freshness and purity of the products.
aboutPage.story4Desc: Then came the time to take a new step: an online presence. The creation of the website gave Nadara a showcase, a space to tell its story, present its products, and share its vision of a more natural and conscious beauty.
aboutPage.relationText: Our relationship with our customers is not limited to selling a product. It is built on trust, transparency, honest communication, and lasting commitment.
